name: Keyboard and mouse
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Plays Ratchet & Clank with a keyboard and mouse: WASD moves, the mouse turns the camera directly (right turns right, up looks up), left click fires, holding right click opens the Quick Select and the mouse picks its slot, Space jumps, Escape pauses, the number keys and the wheel change weapons. In menus the arrows and WASD move, Enter or Space confirm, Escape or Backspace go back, and the mouse points, clicks and scrolls; Space, Enter or Escape skip scenes and movies. Every action can be bound to any key, mouse button or wheel direction, two binds each, with Left-handed and Arrow keys presets. A gamepad keeps working beside it.

settings.name: Mouse sensitivity
settings.description: How far the camera turns for the mouse's motion: at 1, about 9 degrees for 100 pixels. The camera turns as the mouse moves, with no easing.

settings.name: Mouse acceleration
settings.description: 0 for none; more turns a fast flick further than a slow drag.

settings.name: Invert the mouse's up and down
settings.description: Mouse up looks down. The game's own invert options are for the controller and never change the mouse.

settings.name: Camera tilt
settings.description: Whether the camera behind Ratchet keeps the tilt the mouse gives it, or levels out as the game does when the mouse rests.

settings.name: Capture the cursor in play
settings.description: Hides the cursor and keeps it in the window while you play; menus and pausing let it go.

settings.name: Mouse in menus
settings.description: In menus the cursor points at the game's items, a click confirms, right click goes back and the wheel scrolls.

settings.name: Walk speed
settings.description: How far the walk key pushes the stick.

settings.name: Stick ramp (ms)
settings.description: How long the movement keys take to push the stick all the way: a tap nudges, a hold runs.

settings.name: Quick Select dead zone
settings.description: How far, in pixels, the mouse moves before the Quick Select points at a slot.

settings.name: Move forward
settings.description: Pushes the left stick forward.

settings.name: Walk (hold)
settings.description: Moves at the walk speed below while held.

settings.name: Jump
settings.description: Cross. Also confirms in menus and skips scenes and movies.

settings.name: Fire
settings.description: Circle: fires the weapon or gadget in hand.

settings.name: Quick Select (hold)
settings.description: Triangle, held: move the mouse toward a slot and let go to take it.

settings.name: Wrench
settings.description: Square.

settings.name: Strafe
settings.description: L2 (the lock-strafe mod's Hold mode strafes with it).

settings.name: First-person view
settings.description: L1, held.

settings.name: Map
settings.description: Select.

settings.name: Camera behind Ratchet
settings.description: Swings the camera round behind him and levels it.

settings.name: Pause
settings.description: Start in play: the pause menu. In menus it goes back; in a scene or a movie it skips.

settings.name: Quick Select slot 1
settings.description: Takes the item in that slot of the Quick Select at once (slot 1 is the top, then clockwise).

settings.name: Next weapon
settings.description: The next Quick Select slot that holds something.

settings.name: Menu: confirm
settings.description: Cross in menus and dialogs (Space does it too); on the map it travels (Circle). Skips a scene or a movie.

settings.name: Menu: back
settings.description: Triangle in menus; Escape does it too. Skips a scene or a movie.

settings.name: Menu: up
settings.description: The d-pad in menus (held, it repeats); WASD move there too.

settings.name: Menu: Circle
settings.description: Circle in menus, where a page reads it: the Quit page's quit, a value stepped back. On the map, Enter and a click already travel.
